dialogue.content: （こんにちは。本日はよろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.English: (Hello. I look forward to our session today.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: （16:30開始でよろしいですか？）
dialogue.English: (Is it alright to start at 4:30 PM?)

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: （了解しました。）
dialogue.English: (Understood.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。本日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm your counselor. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: こんにちは。夫家族の相続問題で悩んでいます。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm struggling with an inheritance issue with my husband's family.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。とても難しい問題ですよね。もう少し詳しくお話し聞かせてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: I see. That sounds like a very difficult problem. Would you mind telling me a little more about it?

dialogue.content: はい、義父が住んでいる持ち家を譲ってもらう予定でいたのですが、夫と義父が揉めてその話がなくなってしまいそうなんです。
dialogue.English: Yes, we were supposed to inherit the house my father-in-law lives in, but my husband and he had a fight, and now it seems like that plan might fall through.

dialogue.content: 夫は転職までして一緒に地元に戻り今義父の家の近くの賃貸に住んでいるのですが、その話がなくなるとなるとこの先どうしようかと
dialogue.English: My husband even changed jobs so we could move back to our hometown together, and we're now renting near my father-in-law's house, so if that plan falls through, I'm not sure what we should do going forward.

dialogue.content: なるほど。そうだったんですね。突然の心変わりは困ってしまいますね。
dialogue.English: I see. So that's what happened. A sudden change of heart like that must be very upsetting.

dialogue.content: はい、困っています
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: 相続の話があったから、夫さんは転職までして一緒に地元に戻ったというのに、、、
dialogue.English: And this was after your husband went so far as to change jobs and move back to his hometown because of the inheritance discussion...

dialogue.content: 夫さんと義理のお父さんとの間でどのような揉め事があったのですか？
dialogue.English: What kind of disagreement was it between your husband and your father-in-law?

dialogue.content: そうなんです。家を自分たちで購入せず、譲ってもらうつもりでいたので、今から買うには金銭的に難しそうで
dialogue.English: That's right. We were planning on inheriting the house instead of buying one ourselves, so buying one now would be financially difficult.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。家を購入するにも準備が必要ですものね、、、
dialogue.English: I understand. Buying a house requires a lot of preparation, doesn't it...

dialogue.content: 些細なことで、義父から夫に電話があった際に、夫は仕事中だったためちゃんと話を聞けなかったみたいなのですが、その様子に腹を立てたようです。
dialogue.English: It was over something trivial. My father-in-law called my husband, but my husband was in the middle of work and apparently couldn't give him his full attention, and that seems to have angered him.

dialogue.content: えっ！そのような理由でですか、、
dialogue.English: Oh! For a reason like that...?

dialogue.content: いつもは丁寧にお話を聞いていたのですね。
dialogue.English: He usually listens politely, doesn't he?

dialogue.content: 夫が言うには、本当に忙しいタイミングだったみたいで。でも後にして、とか言った訳ではなく夫なりに対応したみたいなんですよね
dialogue.English: According to my husband, it was a really busy time for him. But it's not like he said 'let's talk later' or anything; he apparently handled it as best he could.

dialogue.content: ええ。お仕事中にゆっくり話をするのは難しいですものね。義理のお父さんもその辺りの事情は分かってくれても良さそうですが、、、夫さんもショックを受けられたんじゃないですか?
dialogue.English: Yes. It's difficult to have a long conversation while you're at work, isn't it? It seems like his father could have been more understanding of the circumstances... Your husband must have been shocked, too, wasn't he?

dialogue.content: 夫もだいぶ困ってます。が、父と息子の大喧嘩、って感じでどっちも譲らないというか。
dialogue.English: My husband is quite upset, too. But it's like a huge fight between a father and son, and neither one will back down.

dialogue.content: なるほど。関係が近いからこそ難しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. Sometimes being that close makes things more difficult, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 近くでその様子をみているあなたも疲れてしまいますよね、、、
dialogue.English: Watching that up close must be exhausting for you as well...

dialogue.content: はい。そこの間に私が入っているのですが本当に疲れました。
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm caught in the middle of it, and I'm truly exhausted.

dialogue.content: ええ。そうですよね。このお話はいつ頃のお話しなのですか？喧嘩をしたのは最近ということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, I can imagine. When did this happen? Was the fight recent?

dialogue.content: おとといです。おとといその電話のやりとりがあって、昨日の夜義父の家に行って話してきました。
dialogue.English: The day before yesterday. The phone call happened the day before yesterday, and we went to my father-in-law's house last night to talk.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。つい最近の事なんですね。昨日の夜は、ご夫婦で義理のお父さんの家に行ったのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So this all just happened. Did you and your husband go to your father-in-law's house together last night?

dialogue.content: そうです、空気が和らぐかと思って子供も連れて行きました。
dialogue.English: Yes, we brought our child along, thinking it might ease the tension.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。あなたなりに出来ることを考えて行動に移しているのですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. You're thinking through what you can do and taking action.

dialogue.content: お子さんのお陰で空気は和らぎましたか？
dialogue.English: Did your child's presence help ease the tension?

dialogue.content: はい、最初は夫はいない体で私と子供だけでお邪魔して話してたのですが、後から夫を参加させた途端にまた再燃しちゃったようで、だめでした。
dialogue.English: Well, at first, I went in with just my child and talked to him as if my husband wasn't there. But as soon as I had my husband join us, things flared up again. It didn't work.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。今は顔を合わせるだけでお互いに感情的になってしまうのかもしれませんね、、、
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like just seeing each other makes them both emotional right now...

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: I think so.

dialogue.content: あなたは、今後、夫さんと義理のお父さんにはどのような関係になって欲しいとお考えですか?
dialogue.English: Going forward, what kind of relationship would you like your husband and your father-in-law to have?

dialogue.content: 元々関係は悪くないので、元に戻って欲しいです。
dialogue.English: Their relationship wasn't bad to begin with, so I just want it to go back to how it was.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。相続のお話が出てたくらいですから、決して関係が悪かったわけではないですよね。
dialogue.English: Right. Given that there was talk of inheritance, their relationship couldn't have been bad.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: では、関係を修復するにはどうしたら良いか一緒に考えてみませんか？
dialogue.English: Then, shall we think together about what might help repair the relationship?

dialogue.content: はい。お願いします。元々義父は頑固なので、仲直りできるのか、できずに家を譲り受けられなかったらどうしようかと考えると不安です。
dialogue.English: Yes, please. My father-in-law is stubborn to begin with, so I'm anxious about whether they can reconcile—and if they can't, what we'll do if we can't receive the house.

dialogue.content: なるほど。一番不安に感じているのは相続のことですね。お子さんも居たら余計に大切なことですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. So your biggest anxiety is about the inheritance. With a child, that becomes even more important, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 今までのお話を少し整理させてもらってもいいですか?
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I take a moment to summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: そうですね、ただの親子喧嘩なら放っておきたいのですが、生活に関わることなので放っておけなくて
dialogue.English: Yes, if it were just a simple father-son fight, I'd want to let them be, but since it affects our livelihood, I can't just ignore it.

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please do.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: おととい、些細なことで夫さんと義理のお父さんが喧嘩をしてしまった。
dialogue.English: The day before yesterday, your husband and father-in-law had a fight over something trivial.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 家を譲り受けるという話があったが、喧嘩をした事でなくなってしまうかもしれない。
dialogue.English: There was talk of inheriting the house, but because of the fight, it might not happen.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご家族で義理のお父さんに話をしに行ったが、顔を合わせたら再燃してしまった。
dialogue.English: You went as a family to talk with your father-in-law, but when they were face to face, it flared up again.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたは、相続のお話しがなくなることに不安を感じていて、どうにか関係を修復してもらいたい。
dialogue.English: You're feeling anxious that the inheritance plan might fall through, and you want them to repair their relationship somehow.

dialogue.content: いかがですか？
dialogue.English: Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: はい、そのとおりです。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's exactly right.

dialogue.content: では、どのようにしていくのが良いのか、もう少し質問をさせてもらってもいいですか?
dialogue.English: Then, to figure out the best way forward, may I ask a few more questions?

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: あなたは、お義父さんのことを頑固と仰っていましたが、どのようなことから、そう感じるのですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned that your father-in-law is stubborn. What experiences have led you to feel that way?

dialogue.content: 以前に夫の妹と義父が揉めていまほぼ絶縁状態なんですが、その時のやりとりを見て、一度言ったことは曲げないし、自分が絶対に正しい、という姿勢だったのを見てからですね
dialogue.English: Previously, my husband's younger sister and my father-in-law had a dispute, and they're now almost estranged. Seeing how he handled things then—never backing down from what he'd once said and insisting he was absolutely right—made me feel that way.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。義理の妹さんとは絶縁状態なんですね、、、自分が絶対に正しいと思い込んでいる方と分かち合うのは難しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. So he's estranged from your sister-in-law... It's difficult to find common ground with someone who is convinced they are always right, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 今まで夫さんも気を遣って付き合ってこられたんですかね?
dialogue.English: I wonder if your husband has been careful about how he interacts with him all this time?

dialogue.content: そうですね。言い方あれですけど、昭和の親父って感じです
dialogue.English: Yes. This may not be the best way to put it, but he's like an old-school, traditional father type.

dialogue.content: いや、夫は比較的いい関係保ててたみたいなんですよね
dialogue.English: Actually, it seems my husband had been able to maintain a relatively good relationship with him.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それなら尚更、修復してもらいたいですよね。今までも喧嘩になったことはあるんですか?
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, it's even more important to you that they repair their relationship. Have they had fights like this before?

dialogue.content: ちょこちょこ言い合ってはいましたけど、ここまで義父が怒っている姿は初めてです
dialogue.English: They've had small arguments from time to time, but this is the first time I've ever seen my father-in-law this angry.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。今回は電話を掛けてきたタイミングで、すぐにでも聞いて欲しい内容だったんですかね…?
dialogue.English: I see. I wonder if the topic he called about was something he wanted to discuss right away...?

dialogue.content: (時間になりましたが、ご都合大丈夫でしょうか?）
dialogue.English: (It looks like our time is up. How is your schedule?)

dialogue.content: (すみません予定があり、このあたりで終了させていただけるとありがたいです)
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry, I have another engagement, so I'd appreciate it if we could wrap up here.)

dialogue.content: （はい。途中になってしまい申し訳ありません。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Yes, of course. I'm sorry we had to stop in the middle. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: （では、終了ボタンを押させて頂きます。失礼します。）
dialogue.English: (Then, I will press the end button. Goodbye.)

dialogue.content: 失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Goodbye.
